description: A reusable prototyping board: a grid of holes with metal clip strips underneath that join them in groups.
how_to_use: Push component legs and jumper wires into the holes to build a circuit without soldering. The five holes of one numbered column in the same half (a–e, or f–j) share one metal clip strip, so they're one connection; the centre gap separates the two halves. A lettered row (like row c) runs along the board and is NOT connected. Each power rail (+ red, − blue) is one long connection.
